name: implement
description: Implement one settled GitHub ticket through TDD, observed verification, committed review, and a pull request.
adaptations: Operate against the connected GitHub repository and one settled ticket or small specification without reopening design.
Use an existing specified branch or pull request, otherwise create a feature branch and pull request; direct default-branch mutation requires separate explicit authorization.
Load hidden tdd only when the testing phase begins and load public code-review only after the implementation is committed.
Preserve observed RED, minimum implementation, observed GREEN, useful behavior-preserving cleanup, and stable/public test seams.
Require all verification, commit, CI, and remote-mutation claims to be backed by observed results.
Resolve review ordering as implementation, focused verification, commit, committed-diff review, justified fixes, later commit, final reverification, then pull request.
